title: Brokkr owner-only control-node deployment overlay
$comment: This schema describes an untracked, mode-0600 owner overlay. No live locator belongs in git.

ssh_target.$comment: must be a shell-safe SSH target

deploy_target.$comment: must be an absolute canonical path

runtime_home.$comment: must be an absolute canonical path

registry_path.$comment: must be an absolute canonical path

heimdall_url.$comment: must be an explicit non-secret HTTP(S) endpoint

heimdall_token_source.$comment: must be an absolute server-side path, never a token
